findings.problem: `lop browser status` is a fixed-column block: every English label+padding is 21 cells so values and the 21-space continuation lines (extension_update_note, heartbeat_fallback, legacy_note) line up. ur paddings were not recomputed: value columns are installed 22, daemon_healthy/paired/driving_*/waiting 20, legacy 19, supervisor 19, config_root 18. Values zig-zag in the rendered block.
findings.suggested: Pad each label to 21 cells, e.g. 'کنفیگ روٹ:' + 11 spaces, 'سپروائزر:' + 12, 'انسٹال شدہ:' + 10 …

findings.english: [1;33mheartbeat:           STALE by {age}s (discovery file is not being refreshed)[0m
findings.current: [1;33mہارٹ بیٹ:            {age}s سے باسی (discovery فائل تازہ نہیں ہو رہی)[0m
findings.problem: «{age}s سے باسی» = 'stale since {age}s' and «باسی» is colloquial (stale food); English says stale BY {age}s (overdue by that amount). Upper-case STALE is an alarm word on a yellow line.
findings.suggested: ہارٹ بیٹ:            {age}s سے پرانی (discovery فائل تازہ نہیں ہو رہی) — or «{age}s کی تاخیر سے پرانی»
